notes.title: Azure Wing 2: Gathering Storm: Now Live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34852587/03636f7e5f651bfbdb7a8dab90e507e9bf7d9b54.jpg[/img]

As we continue trying to overturn the unfortunate ratings that we received due to the miscommunication on release that we encountered, we are now live on Kickstarter with the next installment of the Azure Wing series "Gathering Storm"! 

While "Rising Gale" serves to set up the world, "Gathering Storm" will dive into the real meat and bones of the world of Azure Wing! 

For those interested follow the link to kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/azure-wing-2-gathering-storm-visual-novel]here[/url]! 

Check it out to see some of the new faces coming in "Gathering Storm"!

notes.title: Addressing Reviews + Extension Patch
notes.notes:
Hello and thank you for taking the time to look at and/or play Azure Wing Rising Gale! 
We are Sun-Riviera Studios, the developers of Azure Wing! 

We have been reading the reviews since day 1 of release and we now finally have the power to be able to speak out to you all, the community! 

Firstly, we would like to apologize for the discrepancy between the game itself and the original description provided. 
There was a small bit of miscommunication error between us and our publisher and this has since been rectified and fixed to accurately reflect the contents of the game.

Azure Wing is designed as a Fantasy/action kinetic Novel(Mainly), not as a dating Sim or similar such work. And always has been. 

Secondly, we have heard your complaints regarding the length of the story and Azure Wing is being extended by about 2 chapters(15,000-20,000 words) which includes a edit/extension to the current final chapter, and 2 chapters after that.

Thirdly, some reviews have asked if the game will have a sequel or why it stops the way it does. 
Azure Wing is a series as such will span across multiple titles to tell it's full story, similar to how one would buy a book and then the continuation will be in the next release. 

Azure Wing: Rising Gale is the beginning installment that sets up the world and scenario fully, offering a first look at all the characters and the events that have led up to current state of everything. 
The following installment is Azure Wing:Gathering Storm, which is planned for release in mid to late 2020. 

We will continue keeping an eye on reviews, reading feedback and listening to you all, so rest assured that we aren't ignoring or turning a blind eye to the voice of the community! 

If you'd like updates try and support us on patreon where we put  early updates such as character designs,CG previews and project announcements as well as our twitter @SunRivieraWorks where we make big announcements! 


Thank you!
